name: Hip Hinge Drill

instructions.description: Stand a short distance in front of a wall with feet hip width apart.
Place your hands on your hips and soften the knees slightly.
Push the hips backward toward the wall while keeping the spine long and the chest open.
Stand tall again by driving the hips forward without arching the back.

performanceMetrics.notes: Use this as a movement-pattern drill for safe bending mechanics.

variations.variationDescription: Fundamental unloaded pattern that prepares for loaded deadlift mechanics.

variationSuggestions.variationDescription: Add dumbbells or a barbell once the hinge pattern is consistent.

commentsNotes: The movement comes from the hips, not from spinal rounding.
Use the wall as a tactile target for hip travel.
